title: GET /api/stats 200
description: A description of the whole archive, not of any query: the same for every caller and computed once per process. A pre-v1 endpoint, described here unchanged. It takes no search parameters; debug is the only one read. Every list is always present, empty on an index with no cards. took_ms is the engine time of the aggregation that produced the figures, not of the request that returned them.

max_hp.description: The highest printed HP; 0 on an index with none.

per_year.description: Cards per release year, oldest first, with no year missing between the first and the last.

hp.description: Cards per 30-point HP band, named by the band's lower bound, from 0 up to the band holding max_hp.

dsl.description: Present only with debug=1 or debug=true: the Elasticsearch request body behind the figures. It is Elasticsearch's query language, not part of this contract, and clients must not depend on it.

buckets.description: One entry per value of the field, most common first.
